name: 4a-mods
description: 4A-Mods: Claude Code mods by Filip Novotny. Cache Keeper shows costs as plan-limit percent instead of dollars; Model Router gives Claude one agent type per model and effort tier.

plugins.name: cache-keeper
plugins.description: Keeps a big chat's prompt cache warm, warns before an expensive cold restart, shows every local chat on one board (/board), and hands a chat off to a fresh one (/handoff)

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: One agent type per model and effort tier (Haiku for lookups, Sonnet for standard coding, Opus for hard engineering, Fable only when Opus fell short), from one tier table kept current through pull requests (/route)
